meta.name: Trese
meta.description:
In Manila, where dark supernatural forces pervade the criminal underworld, it’s up to Alexandra Trese to keep the peace — but there’s a storm brewing.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When a ghost turns up dead and train passengers go missing, Trese's investigation leads her to an aswang clan by the pier and a corrupt city official.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In a flashback, Trese's father searches for a heart-stealing killer. Trese pursues the sons of two clan leaders who may be behind recent transgressions.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Ramona attempts a blood ritual to exact revenge. Trese, the "boys" and Hank protect an actress as Trese receives a warning of "liars amongst allies."

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Trese fights to undo a spell that sent zombies to attack the police station, Hank tries to uncover details about the coming turmoil.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After a rash of bombings, the Council makes a surprising decision. Trese discovers who’s been responsible for manipulating recent events all along.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With humanity and the supernatural world both in danger, Trese confronts Talagbusao to fight her own destiny — and learns the truth about her father.

meta.slogan: You fear them. They fear her.
